player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.not_your_piece: Acie këdu yen ye yök thïn.
invalid_move.own_piece: Acie lëu bï piny la cuat nhom.

game_action.moved: Wëlcuëi {player_id} acë mäc lööc ku{frm} gɛm ku{to}.

outcome.cannot_move: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acïï lëu bï lɔ.
outcome.higher_score: Aŋuɛ̈n ba kë cï yök ya juak.
